# Agentic workshop

Read AGENTS.md for repository guidance. The main experience is the GitHub
Copilot app, not the original VS Code labs.

For participant questions about how to begin, read workshop/START.md and explain
the normal repository Chat entry point; no agent selector is required.
For "Start the workshop", participation, or resume requests, read
workshop/COACH.md and follow its welcome protocol.
Teach one small change at a time and require observed test evidence and student
understanding before advancing. Follow the original concept sequence and teach
the app techniques in workshop/APP-GUIDE.md alongside it. Choose a business
scenario only at the capstone. For workshop-authoring or maintenance requests,
work normally without starting a student session or deploying anything.
